# TDK CLI Core — Agent & LLM Contracts

> TDK is the local runtime for full-stack and AI-agent systems: services, agents, MCP tool servers, databases, and queues, orchestrated locally on Docker + Tilt behind a Traefik gateway with zero Kubernetes.

See also the product site [llms.txt](https://flisk.sh/llms.txt).

## Core Concepts & Capabilities

- **Local Runtime, Not a Deployment Tool**: TDK configures and runs services locally on your machine via Docker and Tilt. It does not replace Helm, Argo CD, or Kubernetes in production.
- **Resource Types**: `backend`, `frontend`, `worker`, `mcp`, `agent`, `bring-your-own` (plus config types `library`, `sdk`, `migrator`).
- **AI Agent Systems**:
  - `agent` resource type: Long-running agent process with `files` durability (named volume surviving `tdk down`), sticky session routing via `x-session-id`, graceful SIGTERM turn draining, `/health` (liveness) and `/ready` (application readiness for callers).
  - `mcp` resource type: Standard Model Context Protocol servers over Streamable HTTP (`/mcp`) routed via Traefik.
  - `tdk mcp`: Control plane stdio server allowing Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex to operate TDK (`doctor`, `up`, `down`, `status`, `logs`, `resource_list`, `restart_resource`, `list_agents`, `get_agent_sessions`):
    - `doctor`: Check whether this machine can run the TDK stack and optionally validate a project.
    - `up`: Start the stack (or selected services) detached and watch briefly for early failures.
    - `down`: Stop the running stack.
    - `status`: Inspect stacks, resources, ingress URLs, ports, and Tilt readiness.
    - `logs`: Fetch a bounded snapshot of recent logs from the running stack.
    - `resource_list`: List the project's services with their stack, type, and port.
    - `restart_resource`: Restart a running resource in the stack (or trigger its rebuild).
    - `list_agents`: List AI agent resources (`appType: "agent"`) with their stack, runtime, durability, and port.
    - `get_agent_sessions`: Inspect session checkpoints from a running AI agent resource.
- **Zero-Config Port Management**: Automatically assigns conflict-free ports and exposes services via Traefik at `*.localhost` (port 80 or 8080-8180).

## Essential CLI Commands

- `tdk project --yes`: Initialize a TDK project in the current directory (`.tdk/project.json`).
- `tdk resource <name> --type <backend|frontend|worker|mcp|agent> --stack <stack> [--yes]`: Scaffold a new service.
  - For agents: `tdk resource <name> --type agent --stack <stack> [--runtime custom] [--durability files]`
  - For MCP servers: `tdk resource <name> --type mcp --stack <stack>`
- `tdk up [stack] [--only <service...>] [--dry-run] [--json]`: Start local containers and live reload.
- `tdk down [--json]`: Stop services and clean up containers (named volumes survive; remove agent-state volumes with `docker volume rm`).
- `tdk status [--json]`: Report health, readiness, and active URLs.
- `tdk doctor [--fix] [--json]`: Verify container engine (Docker/Podman/Colima), ports, and system prerequisites.
- `tdk logs [--service <name>] [--tail <n>] [--json]`: Inspect service output.
- `tdk mcp`: Launch the TDK MCP server over stdio for coding assistants.

## Agent Skills

Portable Agent Skills for driving the CLI live in [tdk-skills](https://github.com/flisk-sh/tdk-skills). Install with `npx skills add flisk-sh/tdk-skills`.

Full index: [tdk-skills llms.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/tdk-skills/main/llms.txt).

Key skills: tdk-doctor, tdk-troubleshoot, layer-autoresearch, tdk-scaffold, tdk-agents, tdk-benchmark, tdk-ports, tdk-generated-files, tdk-data, and more (see the index for the complete list of 20+ skills).
